Needs changes before merge. The UI test target does not compile at this head. One fix is needed.

## What looks good

- The endpoint laws run before a socket opens. `endpoint::admit` checks the URL. `CheckedResolver` checks every resolved address. Good results from the offline-only tests.
- The client follows no redirect and reads no proxy. Errors carry the host and status, never the key. `provider_message` redacts the key before truncation.
- `ApiKey` has no `Display`. Its `Debug` prints `ApiKey(***)`. Keys come from the environment or the keychain, never `prefs.json`.
- The trial merge with `origin/main` at `3e47b898b` completed without conflicts.
- The dependencies are accepted by the maintainer (PR comment, 2026-11-17). The decision record `docs/decisions/1945-ai-provider-clients.md` and the notices in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` are present and correct.
- File sizes, provenance lines and test placement pass the law check. No golden and no snapshot PNG changed.

## Results (built locally, trial merge with main)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `origin/main` `3e47b898b` | clean, no conflicts |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | ok: 369 passed, 1 ignored |
| `ai_http` | ok: 9 passed |
| `ai_http_review` | ok: 5 passed |
| `view_prefs` | ok: 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo check -p camcraft-ui` (non-test) | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | FAIL to compile, see below |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` | same compile error |

## The repaint-limit test: reproduced

The red is not a flaky harness. It is a compile error in the new test file, at this head alone (no merge needed). The cancel pump calls `poll` with an integer. `poll` takes `&mut History`. Exact output:

```
error[E0308]: mismatched types
   --> crates\ui\src\egui_app\ai_chat\transport_http_tests.rs:159:32
    |
159 |             state.ai_chat.poll(0);
    |                           ---- ^ expected `&mut History`, found integer
```

Because the lib test target does not build, the ai_chat confirmation tests did not run in this review.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport_http_tests.rs:159`: pass a history, not `0`. Use the same pattern as `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3087`: `state.ai_chat.poll(&mut state.history);`. Then push, and the reviewer runs the ui lib suite (the ai_chat tests included) to clear the repaint item.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `post_json_cancellable` builds a current-thread tokio runtime per request. That is simple and correct. A shared runtime is a possible later simplification.
- The "Offline only" checkbox saves prefs directly. That matches the existing prefs switches.
- The previous review's unused-`MIN_LABEL_PX` clippy note no longer applies. Current main has that fix.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
